data.transcriptHtml: Before we wrap up today's meeting, I have something to tell you. As you know, our annual sales workshop was supposed to be held at the Royal Hotel. But I was just informed by the general manager of the hotel that they have sorne problerns with their centralized air conditioning system which serves the whole building. So, We've decided to move the event to the Global Convention Center, which is located on Kimberly Road. I'll send you a map with directions by email right after the meeting. I will be held at the same time, from 9 to noon. If you don't have a ride, please call Rachel Simpson in Administration. Since there are a number of volunteers who will drive to the venue, she will be able to arrange a ride for you. If any problems come up, don't hesitate to let me know immediately.

Tuy nhiên, tôi vừa nhận được thông báo từ giám đốc khách sạn rằng hệ thống điều hòa trung tâm của họ đang gặp sự cố và ảnh hưởng đến toàn bộ tòa nhà. data.transcriptHtml: May I have your attention, please? Due to the recent cold weather, the heating bill for this month turned out to be a lot higher than last month. As the cost of fuel and electricity increase, we are asked to lower our heating costs by conserving power this winter. data.transcriptHtml: Good afternoon, ladies and gentlemen. I'd like to thank you for joining the reopening of the Chicago Civic Theater. As you can see, we completely renovated the main lobby. Also, we. increased the space between rows to allow audience members to sit more comfortably. To commemorate this expansion project, we are proud to present True Love, an award-winning play written and directed by Bruce Joel. He has written it based on Melissa Jackson's famous novel. In fact, both critics and the public have loved it after it premiered at Royal Theater last year. I'm certain that you won't be disappointed. Please note that the performances will be for two days only, May 10 and 11 at 7:30 pm. Tickets are still available at the theater's ticket booth or you can purchase them on our website.

Attention Modern Art Fans!
An exhibition of modern artwork portraying the reality of the 21st century!

The exhibition is hosting Francesco Lavazza's work of art, a renowned modern artist from Spain. Although he is French by origin, he was raised and educated in Spain, where he first found his talent as an artist. When he was 15, his paintings captured the world's attention, with people calling him an "artiste talentueux," or a very gifted artist. When he gained more fame, he began traveling the world looking for new inspiration vision for his work. Collectors of Lavazza's works have given consent to display their collections during the exhibition.

Modern Artwork Exhibition
525 Harvard Avenue, Boston, MA 
1st Floor of the Boston Art Center

August 1st to August 31st 
Monday-Friday: 9:00 am to 7:00 pm 
Saturday: 12:00 pm to 4:00 pm

Tickets can be purchased by phone at 617-298-1921.

MEMO

To: All employees
From: Eric Dash, product design team
Date: December 12
Subject: Request for product design idea

The product design team welcomes your ideas regarding the design of new products. If you want to send us your ideas, and we hope you do, we simply request that you send them to us via email. You cannot submit an idea from someone else, though. The idea must be an original creation of the individual who signs the disclosure form and the signee must have the exclusive right to submit the idea to our company. When your idea is successfully submitted, we will conduct a preliminary evaluation on your submission. Following the preliminary evaluation, if we are interested in pursuing your project, you will be given financial compensation matching the quality of the idea. Once your idea is accepted, your submission and its content will automatically become the property of the product design team.
Please contact me if you would like me to send you more information on submission guidelines. We look forward to your participation!

As a product development team manager, I am very interested in design and am sending you a draft of my idea in the enclosed attachment. I would like to talk with you more in detail if your team is interested in developing my idea. Please contact me at extension 539 at your earliest convenience.

APPLICATIONS FOR CAPETECH INTERNSHIP PROGRAM NOW OPEN!

Cape Technology Solutions Ltd. is a specialized software development business that focuses on building, deploying and maintaining user-friendly applications for our customers. At Capetech, we consider our employees to be our greatest asset and vital to the company's future.
The Capetech Internship Program is a 12-month intensive development program commencing in September each year. This program allows you to gain valuable work experience and theoretical training, while also earning a modest salary. The Capetech Internship Program is your chance to build the foundation for a successful career in the IT industry. Upon completion of the program, successful interns may have the opportunity to gain permanent employment within the company based upon their performance during the course of the internship.
Applicants must be in possession of a completed IT-related degree, with preference given to those who have previous IT-related working experience, though this is not required. Also, preference will be given to disabled applicants.
To apply, complete the application form and submit it with your resume to recruitment@ capetech.com. Applicants will be asked to come in and complete a written technical assessment. If successful, they will be invited to attend an interview with one of our Development Managers. Successful candidates will then be sent an offer to take part in the Capetech Internship Program.

To: recruitment@capetech.com
From: andrew@aliban.com
Date: July 20
Re: Internship opportunity

To whom it may concern,

My name is Andrew Martin and this e-mail is in regard to the Capetech Internship Program that was advertised on lookforintership.com. I am hereby applying for the Capetech Internship Program. I graduated from State University in June with a bachelor's degree in computer science and am interested in opportunities in the IT industry. At college, I worked in the Earth and Planetary Science Department to create a graphic user-interfacing software for viewing data sent by space. I have also worked as an intern with Lorel Imaging Systems for the past two summers in their software engineering department. This experience would be applicable to the creation of the type of user-friendly software that you are interested in.

I believe my training has given me the skills to make me a valuable contributor, and the skills and experience I have to offer would be very useful for Capetech. If you wish to contact me, I can be reached by phone at 908-3433 or at the e-mail address above. I look forward to hearing from you.

Sincerely,

Andrew Martin

Opening of a Benjamin Torown Music Academy!

270 South Bay Rd. Virginia, DC 71293

The well-known conductor Benjamin Torown is back in town! After his farewell orchestra last month in Milan, Italy, he came back to home to open up his own music academy. He says that the 'opening of his own academy is to fulfill his ultimate goal, which is to cultivate as many gifted musicians as possible."

The following classes are available:

- Conducting Class: Mondays and Fridays from 2 p.m. to 7 p.m., Room #1

- Orchestra Class: Tuesday-Thursday from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m., Room #1

    + Tuition Fee: $200 per month

- Private Lesson: Saturdays and Sundays from 2 p.m. to 5 p.m., Room #3

    + Tuition Fee: $100 per week

- Consulting Service: $40 per hour

  Monday         9:00 a.m. - 11:00 a.m

Please be advised that there is limited amount of space available for each class. Visit our academy or e-mail me at martinluke@musicacademy.com to reserve your spot as soon as possible. Furthermore, it is suggested that you receive some consulting before registering for a class.

Hope to see you all soon!

To: omarhussein@musiclover.com

From: martinluke@musicacademy.com

Thank you for your e-mail application sent on the 10th of August.

If you are interested in becoming a conductor, please visit the academy during the consulting hours for more details so that we can decide whether you are suitable for the conducting class or a private lesson.

I sincerely regret that the academy is not able to provide you with a space for the requested class and hope to see you soon during the consulting service hours.

Sincerely,

Martin Luke
